CHAPTER XIII
PAYMENT OF TAX BY SELF-ASSESSMENT

113.
(1) Any  income  tax  which  any  person  or
partnership  is  liable  to  pay  under  this Act  for  any  year  of
assessment shall be paid by such person or partnership to the
Commissioner-General in four instalments on or before the
fifteenth day  respectively of August, November and February
in that year of assessment and the fifteenth day of May of the
next succeeding year of assessment, notwithstanding that no
assessment has been made on him or it by an Assessor. Each
such  instalment  is  hereinafter  referred  to  as  a  “quarterly
instalment”.
(2) The quarterly instalment of a tax payable by any person
or partnership for any year of assessment, shall be one-quarter
of the tax payable by him or it for that year of assessment.
